_comment: RetroDiffusion prompts for every item icon (tools/art/rd_icons.py). Prompts describe the subject only; the style handles the pixel-art look. Entries with `from` are not generated: they reuse another icon and add a badge (fertilized). Entries with `rendered` are drawn by that script (the carcasses, from the animal models) and never generated here.
